tools.name: idiom_quick
tools.description: Review a public page at an absolute HTTP(S) URL with zero configuration and no model. Returns ranked Top 5 issues, complete evidence IDs and absolute report paths; writes local reports, captures desktop/mobile in light/dark and safely probes controls once per page (first viewport, light; only GET/HEAD/OPTIONS requests leave the browser; destructive-looking controls are skipped). For configured flows or intended designs use idiom_check. For requested repairs use idiom_fix_plan, then idiom_verify.

viewports.description: Preset viewports; defaults to both desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844)

probe.description: Run the safe interaction probe once per page at the first viewport in light; default true

probeBudgetMs.description: Per-page probe budget in ms, default 45000 (CLI --probe-budget)

tools.name: idiom_check
tools.description: Capture a configured flow, run deterministic UI checks and compare declared intended designs (HTML, Figma, images or live sites). Returns ranked Top 5 issues with selectors, measurements, fix instructions, crops, counts and baseline new/fixed/pre-existing comparison. all=true reviews every live finding without recording/comparing a baseline. Attach references with idiom_design_add; a human chooses between conflicting references with idiom_choose. For requested repairs use idiom_fix_plan, then idiom_verify.

flow.description: Configured flow manifest ID; optional with changed

changed.description: Select states affected by Git changes; true uses the default merge base, a string names a base

states.description: Exact configured state IDs; omitted means every state

viewports.description: Exact configured viewport names; omitted means every flow viewport

all.description: Return full live findings and bypass baseline bootstrap/comparison

isolatedRegistry.description: Ignore the primary checkout's finding names (throwaway worktrees); defaults to findingNames.isolatedRegistry

tools.name: idiom_issue
tools.description: Read full original evidence for a returned finding, group or issue ID. Includes members and sibling groups, selectors, measurements, repair instructions and the representative PNG crop as image content; performs no capture.

id.description: Opaque finding/group/issue ID from a tool or project catalog

tools.name: idiom_fix_plan
tools.description: Capture a full flow and hand the calling agent the exact idiom fix repair prompt and selected original finding records. Excludes rejected work; never launches a repair agent or records a decision. Edit source yourself, then call idiom_verify with the returned arguments.

top.description: Maximum finding assignments, in idiom fix order

tools.name: idiom_verify
tools.description: Prove original findings fixed using two calibrated full-flow captures pinned to their source run. Reports each fixed/reproduced/unverifiable verdict and all introduced deterministic findings, including minor regressions outside the target state. Requires complete successful original coverage; quick evidence is unsupported.

flow.description: Same configured flow as the original evidence

id.description: Original finding ID returned by check, issue or fix-plan

findings.description: Unmodified verification references from check, issue or fix-plan, all from one source run

tools.name: idiom_context
tools.description: Read the bounded project design brief before building UI: tokens, scales, rules/design law, craft checks, prohibitions and accepted work. Read-only; no browser or model.

tools.name: idiom_flows
tools.description: List validated configured flows with their titles, ordered states, viewports and color schemes. If no manifests exist, suggests idiom_init with flows:true. Every configured tool validates first; validation errors return as tool errors. Read-only; no browser or model.

tools.name: idiom_decide
tools.description: Record an explicit human accept/reject judgment with a reason for one canonical finding or exactly one durable group's members. Writes the project decision log with instance scope; never accepts siblings implicitly, changes Git or repairs source. Quick-only evidence cannot receive project decisions. For a design system question (a ruling-N id from idiom_check), add-step records the value as a token step for its context in the design file (token optional, defaults to the suggestion) and drift keeps reporting it as one grouped issue; skip by not answering.

id.description: Canonical finding or group ID, or a design system question's ruling-N

decision.description: Explicit human judgment: accept/reject a finding, add-step/drift a design system question

token.description: add-step only: token name; defaults to the suggestion

tools.name: idiom_init
tools.description: Scaffold PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md and .idiom in the bound project root without data loss, non-interactively (never overwrites changed files, never wires Autobuild). flows:true also generates a site flow from filesystem and running local routes. Returns files created/replaced/unchanged/preserved and next steps.

flows.description: Generate .idiom/flows/site.json from filesystem and running local routes

surface.description: Project surface for the generated site flow

tools.name: idiom_setup_prompt
tools.description: The versioned, repository-aware setup prompt `idiom init` hands to a coding agent: server command/port/readyUrl, seed data and test accounts from repo fixtures only, routes, a first 3–8-state flow, PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md, ending at idiom_ready. Follow it in this session. Read-only.

tools.name: idiom_ready
tools.description: Return the same verdict as idiom init --validate: validate every flow, then boot the first (or named) flow's server once. Reports ready, or the first problem and its fix; setup is done only when ready is true. Not-ready is a result, not a tool error. Runs project commands; creates nothing.

flow.description: Configured flow ID to boot; defaults to the first flow

tools.name: idiom_design_add
tools.description: Attach an intended design to an authored state in a flow manifest: a local HTML file/directory or PNG/JPEG/WebP image inside the bound root, a prototype URL, or a Figma frame URL. Writes only the flow manifest. Figma frames need FIGMA_TOKEN in the MCP server's environment; no argument accepts credentials.

source.description: HTTP(S) URL, Figma frame URL with node-id, or a path relative to the bound root

flow.description: Disambiguate the state across flow manifests

name.description: Add or replace a named reference, keeping the state's other references

viewport.description: Compare this reference only at this project viewport

tools.name: idiom_choose
tools.description: Record a human's choice between disagreeing intended-design references for one idiom:design-decision finding. A human must name the intended reference and supply the reason; the tool records exactly that reference, never infers one, and preserves the reason verbatim. Writes the project decision log.

id.description: Canonical idiom:design-decision finding ID (not a group)

reference.description: Reference name the human chose, as listed in the finding

tools.name: idiom_tickets
tools.description: Emit accepted findings as clustered ticket proposals (grouped by component and category) into a file-tracker triage directory inside the bound project. Only human-accepted findings become tickets; tickets land in triage, never ready, and are promoted by a human. Returns absolute ticket paths.

findings.description: Accepted finding IDs; omitted means every accepted finding

out.description: Ticket directory relative to the bound root; defaults to the file tracker's triage

tools.name: idiom_sweep
tools.description: Capture a configured flow, run every deterministic check, then a per-surface model critique with crops and measured geometry. Returns every ranked finding and report paths; optionally emits clustered proposals into triage. Model credentials come only from the server's environment; a degraded critique is a completed result. Use all:true for a whole-product cleanup set; deterministicOnly runs without model credentials. maxTickets caps new tickets after grouping and deduplication.

flow.description: Configured flow manifest ID; exactly one of flow or all is required

from.description: Sweep this existing immutable capture run ID

latest.description: Sweep the newest fully passing capture of this flow at HEAD

emitTickets.description: Emit clustered proposals into this triage directory, relative to the bound root

tools.name: idiom_coverage
tools.description: List the app's routes and which configured flows capture them, so routes no flow captures are visible (silence about an uncaptured route is not approval). Discovers app/ and pages/ routes, or crawls same-origin links from a running page. Also returns state coverage: per flow and state, which viewports, colour schemes, reduced-motion modes, network replays, interactions, and data states the latest capture observed, with the change that covers each missing one (coverage of what was reviewed, not a quality measure). Read-only; no capture or model.

crawl.description: Discover routes from the links on this running page

states.description: Return only state coverage (skips route discovery, so projects without filesystem routes work)

tools.name: idiom_doctor
tools.description: Boot the application server once, exactly as a capture would, and diagnose why a run could not start: validates config and the finding-name registry, notes a dirty tree, binds the port, runs setup and server.build, starts server.start, loads server.readyUrl and shuts down. Returns pass/fail per step with timings and a fix for known causes (pinned port, missing server.env variable, port in use, wrong readiness URL). Runs project commands; captures nothing.

flow.description: Configured flow ID; runs its setup steps and skips Electron flows

tools.name: idiom_baseline
tools.description: Show or record a flow's compact deterministic finding baseline. show reads recorded commits and which record applies at HEAD; record captures (or reuses from/latest) a clean committed HEAD and writes the baseline file. Commit that file deliberately, only after intentional changes. Never changes Git.

action.description: show reads the baseline; record writes a new record

flow.description: Configured flow ID; optional when exactly one flow exists

from.description: record only: use this existing immutable capture run ID

latest.description: record only: use the newest fully passing capture at HEAD

tools.name: idiom_brief_triage
tools.description: Call before writing a ticket, spec or code that adds or changes visible UI, or when a request involves a design decision. Returns no design decision (proceed) or design decision with open questions and a triage id; then call idiom_brief_plan with that id. One bounded model call via the project's review provider, stored under .idiom/briefs/triage/; noModel returns the rubric for you to apply instead. Pass the request verbatim, or a draft ticket file.

request.description: The request or draft ticket text, verbatim

file.description: A draft ticket file inside the bound project root

noModel.description: Return the rubric and answer shape instead of calling a model

tools.name: idiom_brief_plan
tools.description: Research instructions for a design decision: the open questions, the project's reference products by tier, what to check (hover, touch, keyboard, small screen, empty and error states), standards to look for, a time budget and the exact input idiom_brief_record accepts. Follow it within its budget, then call idiom_brief_record. Pass the triage id from idiom_brief_triage, or the request with your own questions.

request.description: The request verbatim, when there is no triage id

questions.description: With request: the open questions to research; omitted runs a model triage first

tools.name: idiom_brief_record
tools.description: Validate your research and options and store the decision brief as .idiom/briefs/<slug>.json and a ticket-ready .md. Returns every validation issue as path: message so you can fix them in one round. On success returns ask: unless ask.proceed.allowed, ask the human with ask.askUserQuestion verbatim (AskUserQuestion; ask.text where that tool is absent), then call idiom_brief_decide.

brief.description: The brief input, in the shape idiom_brief_plan returns

tools.name: idiom_brief_decide
tools.description: Record the human's choice on a decision brief and regenerate its ticket-ready Markdown. Call only with the human's explicit choice, or with the recommendation when ask.proceed.allowed was true and you told them so. Then use .idiom/briefs/<slug>.md as the ticket, unless the result warns that it is not ticket-ready.
